name: Generate and Commit Index on: workflow_dispatch: # Runs ONLY when manually triggered jobs: build-and-commit: runs-on: ubuntu-latest permissions: contents: write # Required to commit back to the repository steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Set up Python uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: '3.x' - name: Generate index.html run: | python3 << 'EOF' import os from urllib.parse import quote def get_tree_html(dir_path, indent=0): html = "" try: entries = sorted(os.listdir(dir_path)) except PermissionError: return "" # Filter out hidden files/folders like .git, .github entries = [e for e in entries if not e.startswith('.')] dirs = [e for e in entries if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(dir_path, e))] files = [e for e in entries if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(dir_path, e))] # Avoid linking to itself in the root directory if dir_path == '.' and 'index.html' in files: files.remove('index.html') for d in dirs: full_path = os.path.join(dir_path, d) rel_path = full_path.replace('\\', '/') html += " " * indent + f"
  • 📁 {d}/\n" html += " " * indent + "
      \n" html += get_tree_html(full_path, indent + 1) html += " " * indent + "
    \n" html += " " * indent + "
    • \n" for f in files: full_path = os.path.join(dir_path, f) rel_path = full_path.replace('\\', '/') # URL-encode the path to safely handle spaces and special characters safe_rel_path = quote(rel_path) html += " " * indent + f"
  • 📄 {f}
    • \n" return html def generate_index(): html_content = f""" Repository File Index

    📂 Repository File Index

      {get_tree_html('.')}
    """ with open('index.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(html_content) if __name__ == '__main__': generate_index() print("index.html generated successfully.") EOF - name: Commit and push if changed run: | git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]" git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" git add index.html if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m "chore: auto-generate index.html [skip ci]" git push else echo "No changes to index.html, skipping commit." fi
